name: All-in-one domain and website checks platform

mentions.name: All-in-one domain and website checks platform
mentions.description: This Django app consolidates the many domain and website checks the author would otherwise run through 10+ different services into a single place, and adds scheduled monitoring and alerting. It is currently hosted on a Raspberry Pi running Coolify in a home server, exposed through a Cloudflare Tunnel.
mentions.problem: Running 10+ different checks on domains/websites required juggling 10+ different services.
mentions.source_excerpt: Frustrated with running 10+ different checks on domains/websites I've built or working on with 10+ different services, I've built - with help from Claude Code - a Django app that tries to wrap all those key checks into one place. On top of that, I've built in scheduled monitoring and alerting.
